subject: VoltEdge — VPC / Private deployment — quick follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@voltedge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: VoltEdge discovery recap + suggested next steps

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery call and suggested next steps: 

Key notes:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + internal knowledge retrieval (high QPS, multi-region users).
- Current pain: latency spikes during peak and compliance requirement to keep data in a VPC for governed customers.
- Expected monthly usage: ~600M tokens (mixed short/long responses).

Options we discussed:
1) Hosted API to get started quickly — fastest time to value, lower operational overhead.
2) Dedicated / Reserved capacity for predictable throughput and cost predictability.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment — fits compliance requirement you mentioned; more setup but gives private networking and tighter control.

Recommended next steps:
- If compliance is the gating factor, let's prioritize evaluating the Private VPC option. I can loop in our infra SE (Dev) to do a short technical call and share a checklist for network/firewall and KMS integration.
- If timeline is tight and you just want to prototype, we can start on Hosted and plan a Dedicated/Private rollout later.

Attachments: VoltEdge-VPC-options.pdf (high-level deployment choices), redwood-dedicated-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30-min technical sync next week (Tue/Wed) with Dev to validate network requirements?

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Hart <alex.hart@voltedge.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 17:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VoltEdge discovery recap + suggested next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary.

Two quick items: 
- Compliance is definitely a gating factor for our enterprise customers (they require VPC/Private).
- Could you send a short checklist of what our network team needs to open (IPs/ports) and how KMS/HSM integration would look? That will help me get this into our internal approval queue.

I can do Tue morning next week for the technical sync. Looping Sophie (procurement) in for visibility.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Product, VoltEdge
alex.hart@voltedge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@voltedge.com>, Sophie Green <sophie.green@voltedge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VoltEdge discovery recap + suggested next steps

Alex / Sophie — great, thanks for confirming. Attaching the network checklist and our high-level VPC deployment options (see attached). Highlights below: 

- Network checklist (summary):
  * Allow outbound HTTPS from the VPC to Redwood control plane IPs (list in attached PDF).
  * If using Private (VPC peering), we'll request a CIDR range for routing and set up secure peering; no internet-facing endpoints required.
  * KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM). We'll share the integration steps and an example policy.

- Timeline: average customer onboard for Private VPC is ~4–8 weeks (depends on procurement and network approvals).
- Price considerations: Dedicated/Private has committed capacity pricing — see the pricing sheet. We can propose a pilot reservation to align with your traffic profile.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tech sync Tue 11 Jun 2026 09:30 PT (Dev will walk through checklist and answer network questions). Please confirm.
2) If procurement wants an initial T&Cs/quote, Rachel can kick off a draft SOW / term sheet for your review.

Attachments: VoltEdge-VPC-options.pdf; redwood-dedicated-pricing-sheet.xlsx

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@voltedge.com>, Sophie Green <sophie.green@voltedge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 19:30:00 +0000
Subject: VoltEdge — quick follow-up (bump)

Alex / Sophie — wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Quick check: is VPC/private deployment still a priority for VoltEdge in the next quarter? If so, we should lock a short tech sync and get a procurement-ready quote to keep the onboarding timeline within the 4–8 week window.

If priorities shifted and Hosted first makes more sense, that's also a low-friction way to prototype while we prepare procurement docs in parallel. Either way, curious on timing so we can align resources.

If it helps, we can provide a short one-page summary for your legal/procurement teams that highlights data residency, KMS options, and the SLA. Happy to send that over.

Thanks — would appreciate a quick reply with your preference or an ok to put a 09:30 PT slot on the calendar next Tue.

—
Marissa
